articles.summary: SBA acquisition loan software runs 7(a) deals from intake to funding. Look for extraction, transcript checks, global DSC, and fraud review.

articles.summary: Rules are easier to explain, and ML can find more risk signal. Many lenders combine both: rules set policy, and models rank risk.
articles.title: Rules-Based vs. Machine Learning Credit Models: A Lender's Guide

articles.summary: Track SBA-serviced loans in the MySBA Loan Portal at lending.sba.gov. For lender-held 7(a) and 504 loans, check status and pay through your lender.
articles.title: SBA Loan Tracking: How to Check Your Status, Payments, and Documents

It also covers third-party risk management under the 2023 interagency guidance, so procurement, IT, and lending teams can compare vendors with confidence.

articles.title: What Is Risk-Based Pricing? A Guide for US Lenders
